title: LP-dual survey (informational)
output_head:
Scanned 3523 witness files; 31 flagged as LP/SDP/operator-selection.

ℹ 2 flagged witness(es) record a float64 solve for a measured reason (F64_BACKEND_EXEMPT):
  ·  deuteron-real-sdp.witness.json   backend=scipy-highs
     The phase-B methods stack extra equality rows onto A_eq, which the canonical `solve_operator_selection_lp` cannot express — it takes the net row plus Gx >= 0 and nothing else. So this is a raw scipy solve of a genuinely different LP, with no MPFR path today: the same gap `solve_frobenius_dual_lp` has, and for the same reason. It records `backend` honestly rather than dropping into the unannotated bucket, which is exactly the laundering this list exists to make unnecessary. Bean `qou/ftuv`.
  ·  rho-k-h3a-gg-trajectory.witness.json   backend=scipy-highs
     t = 1/(dim_q · |y·χ|) with a 1e-15 floor spans 1.1 … 1e15, a cost dynamic range of 15 orders. Clarabel's interior-point method returns a false `infeasible` on it (all nucleons NaN) where HiGHS's simplex solves it. Not precision — 167/333/500 bits fail identically — and not fixable by rescaling, which shifts magnitude but not the ratio between entries. Measured 2026-08-23, bean `qou/ftuv`.

ℹ 8 flagged witness(es) record no backend at all — produced before the field existed. Reported, not failed: the gate ratchets on NEW float64 solves.

WARN — 6/31 flagged witnesses missing LP dual fields.
